nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Configuration file defining exclusion patterns for the understand-anything analysis tool. Currently excludes /obj, /iso, and /jx directories. Follows .gitignore-style syntax with commented patterns for test files and additional build artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: gitignore-style syntax; built-in exclusions for node_modules, .git, etc.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Understand-anything configuration with output language set to English.

nodes.name: interruptstubs.s
nodes.summary: x86 assembly interrupt stubs using GNU as macros. Defines HandleException (0x00-0x13) and HandleInterruptRequest (0x00-0x0F, 0x31, 0x80) entry points. The int_bottom routine saves registers (general purpose via push), calls the C++ InterruptManager::HandleInterrupt, restores registers, and returns via iret. Includes an InterruptIgnore stub for unused interrupts.
nodes.languageNotes: GNU as (AT&T syntax); assembler macros; mangled C++ symbol names

nodes.name: loader.s
nodes.summary: Multiboot-compliant boot loader entry point in x86 assembly. Sets up a 2MB kernel stack, calls global constructors (callConstructors), then jumps to kernelMain with multiboot info (EBX) and magic (EAX). Halts on return.
nodes.languageNotes: GNU as (AT&T syntax); multiboot header; 2MB bss stack
